comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: Fixes from a security review
themes.text: A review of the whole runtime found places where a safety rule did not apply. Each place gets a fix and a test.

themes.title: Faster writes to arrays and strings
themes.text: A write to a nested array, or an append to a string in a property, changes the value in place. The cost no longer grows with the size of the value.

themes.title: A request path that scales with cores
themes.text: Each core keeps its own copy of what every request reads. Static files are read on a separate thread.

themes.title: A JSON reader and writer made for Novis
themes.text: `Core\Json` reads and writes Novis values directly. The `nvs` binary also becomes smaller.
